coverage: Three curated records from developer documentation. This is a limited reviewed collection, not a live or comprehensive news feed.

nodes.name: H800 GPU

events.title: Qwen3 release enters the record
events.summary: A historical release provides a dated anchor for the Qwen3 series. Later variants need their own evidence.
events.scope: Series-level release, explicitly dated in the developer’s release history.
events.unknowns: Original training hardware, facilities, serving providers, customer adoption and business outcomes are not assessed in this update.

events.title: o4-mini: a shutdown date is announced
events.summary: The SDK records a 23 October 2026 shutdown schedule. Treat it as a provider announcement until completion is verified.
events.scope: Provider SDK notes reviewed on 18 October 2026. The announcement’s original publication date is not established.
events.unknowns: Actual service status, affected customer counts, migrations and commercial effects have not been verified.

events.title: DeepSeek-V3: trace the documented stack
events.summary: Training on H800 and support from three inference runtimes are recorded separately. Follow each connection back to the developer’s evidence.
events.scope: A review of existing documentation on 18 October 2026, not a new model launch. Runtime support does not identify a production serving provider.
events.unknowns: Training location, cloud contracts, chip manufacturing path, live serving deployments, customer adoption and financial outcomes are not established by these records.

versions.subject: qwen

versions.subject: openai

versions.subject: deepseek
versions.statement: DeepSeek presents DeepSeek-V3 as its model.
versions.scope: The original DeepSeek-V3 record. No inference about later V3 revisions, R1 or V4 infrastructure.

citations.excerpt: We present DeepSeek-V3, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters with 37B activated for each token.

versions.subject: deepseek-v3
versions.statement: DeepSeek reports 2.788 million H800 GPU hours for DeepSeek-V3 full training.
versions.scope: A developer-reported training input for this model. It does not identify a facility, cloud supplier, chip purchase value, serving allocation or total company R&D cost.

citations.excerpt: Despite its excellent performance, DeepSeek-V3 requires only 2.788M H800 GPU hours for its full training.

versions.subject: vllm
versions.statement: DeepSeek documents vLLM v0.6.6 support for DeepSeek-V3 FP8 and BF16 inference.
versions.scope: Version-specific runtime compatibility in the reviewed document. It does not establish that DeepSeek or any named customer operates vLLM in production.

citations.excerpt: v0.6.6 supports DeepSeek-V3 inference for FP8 and BF16 modes on both NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

versions.subject: sglang
versions.statement: DeepSeek documents SGLang v0.4.1 support for running DeepSeek-V3 on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
versions.scope: Runtime compatibility, not original training hardware, a managed endpoint or verified production deployment.

citations.excerpt: fully supports running DeepSeek-V3 on both **NVIDIA and AMD GPUs**, making it a highly versatile and robust solution.

versions.subject: tensorrt-llm
versions.statement: DeepSeek documents TensorRT-LLM support for DeepSeek-V3 BF16 and INT4/INT8 weight-only inference.
versions.scope: The pinned document describes FP8 support as in progress. This is a documentation observation, not a current runtime test or evidence of training hardware.

citations.excerpt: now supports the DeepSeek-V3 model, offering precision options such as BF16 and INT4/INT8 weight-only. Support for FP8 is currently in progress and will be released soon.

assessments.subject: vllm
assessments.title: A possible self-hosting route
assessments.mechanism: Documented runtime support could let an operator evaluate serving the model on its own infrastructure. Compatibility alone does not establish a successful deployment or a cost advantage.
assumptions: The operator has suitable hardware, memory and engineering capacity.
The documented runtime and model weights meet its workload, license and security requirements.
Operational evaluation succeeds and the operator chooses to deploy.
assessments.horizon: After an operator completes evaluation; no deployment date estimated.
assessments.unknowns: No named operator, adoption, revenue shift or capacity effect is established.
